description: SCHEMA ONLY. This file defines the shape of a tissue/route profile for the future Animated Tissue View. It contains NO populated profiles: every numeric parameter must come from a verified entry in data/source-registry.json and pass the Phase-3 eligibility gate before it may appear here. Populating profiles is gated on user approval (Phase 17). An empty 'profiles' array is intentional and correct at this stage.

eligibility_status_enum.QUALIFIED: Validated or independently testable model + suitable quantitative data. May produce quantitative predictions.
eligibility_status_enum.RESEARCH_SUPPORTED: Multiple credible studies, meaningful uncertainty / limited validation. May produce quantitative predictions only with explicit uncertainty and justification.
eligibility_status_enum.ILLUSTRATIVE_ONLY: Insufficient evidence for quantitative prediction. Shown as schematic only, never as a prediction.
eligibility_status_enum.EXCLUDED: Evidence missing/incompatible/unsuitable. Not implemented; selector entry disabled with explanation.

profile_field_definitions.route: administration route this profile is valid for (must match an entry in routes)
profile_field_definitions.process_represented: which of the 9 processes in docs/model-scope.md this profile models (must be a subset the current solver actually computes)
profile_field_definitions.geometry: spatial idealisation (e.g. 1D slab, 1D spherical) — must match a solver the code implements
profile_field_definitions.parameters: object mapping parameter name -> { value|range, unit, source_id, status (measured|fitted|assumed), species, confidence, uncertainty }
profile_field_definitions.applicable_controls: which existing UI controls are scientifically meaningful for this profile
profile_field_definitions.inapplicable_controls: existing controls that must be shown as disabled/not-used for this profile
profile_field_definitions.extrapolation_domain: supported parameter ranges; values outside trigger an extrapolation warning
profile_field_definitions.evidence_grade: summary grade shown in UI (mirrors eligibility_status)
profile_field_definitions.source_ids: list of source-registry ids backing this profile
